name: VideoVault After Effects Extension
releaseNotes:
- Telemetry now survives the Desktop App being closed: if an activity event can't reach the local bridge (Desktop App not running, or the send otherwise fails), it's held in a small local queue instead of being dropped, and gets sent automatically the next time the Desktop App becomes reachable - on the next successful send, on every ~45s heartbeat tick, and once when the panel first loads. Queued events are capped at 500 and 7 days old to avoid unbounded growth if the Desktop App stays closed for a long time, and are sent in batches of 20 per cycle so a large backlog doesn't open a burst of connections at once.
- Fixed a bug in this file's own header comment (introduced in 1.3.0) that prematurely closed a block comment, which could break the file from loading in some JS engines depending on how they classify the file - functionally the same 1.3.0 telemetry fix, this just makes sure the file actually parses everywhere.
